title: Cold damage
wikitext:
{{redirect|Cold Damage|the passive skill|Cold Damage (passive skill)}} '''Cold damage''' is one of the five [[damage type]]s and is one of the three types which count as [[elemental damage]]. [[Hit]]ting an enemy with cold damage can inflict [[chill]]. [[Critical strikes]] with cold damage can inflict [[freeze]]. Cold damage is mitigated by cold [[resistance]] and reduction to cold [[damage taken]]. [[Skill]]s which deal or affect cold damage have the Cold [[Gem tag]]. Some effects [[Damage conversion|convert]] other types of damage into cold. ==Gems== A list of [[gem]]s with the [[gem tag]]: [[:Category:Cold (gem tag)|Cold]] ===Attack skill gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Cold" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Attack" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ===Spell skill gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Cold" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Spell" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ===Other skill gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Cold" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Attack" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Spell" AND NOT skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ===Support skill gems=== {{Drop enabled gem table |where=skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Cold" AND skill_gems.gem_tags HOLDS "Support" }} ==Base items== The following base items are related to cold damage. {{Drop enabled base item table |where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Cold%Damage%" AND items.class_id NOT IN ("Active Skill Gem", "Support Skill Gem") |large=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Unique items== ===Flat added Cold Damage=== [[Unique item]]s that add a flat amount of cold damage or grant {{il|Added Cold Damage Support}} to socketed skills. {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables = item_stats |join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName |where = item_stats.id LIKE "%added_cold_damage%" |level=1 |stat_column1_header=Local Attack
Cold Damage |stat_column1_format=%s-%s |stat_column1_stat_format=separate |stat_column1_stat1_id=local_minimum_added_cold_damage |stat_column1_stat2_id=local_maximum_added_cold_damage |stat_column2_header=Global Attack
Cold Damage |stat_column2_format=%s-%s |stat_column2_stat_format=separate |stat_column2_stat1_id=attack_minimum_added_cold_damage |stat_column2_stat2_id=attack_maximum_added_cold_damage |stat_column3_header=Global Spell

Attack Cold Damage |stat_column4_format=%s-%s |stat_column4_stat_format=separate |stat_column4_stat1_id=spell_and_attack_minimum_added_cold_damage |stat_column4_stat2_id=spell_and_attack_maximum_added_cold_damage |stat_column5_header=Global
Cold Damage |stat_column5_format=%s-%s |stat_column5_stat_format=separate |stat_column5_stat1_id=global_minimum_added_cold_damage |stat_column5_stat2_id=global_maximum_added_cold_damage }} |stat_column4_stat1_id=base_cold_damage_%_to_convert_to_chaos }} ==Passive skills== There are [[passive skill]]s that grant cold damage bonuses. ===Cold damage=== These passive skills grant increased cold damage. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "cold_damage_+%" }} ===Cold damage with attacks=== These passive skills grant increased cold damage with [[weapon]]s. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "cold_damage_with_attack_skills_+%" }} ===Wand Cold Damage=== {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id = "wand_physical_damage_%_to_add_as_cold" }} ===Cold penetration=== {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%reduce_enemy_cold_resistance%" }} ===Converted to cold=== These passive skills [[damage conversion|convert damage]] of other types to cold damage. {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%convert_to_cold%" }} ===Cluster Jewel passive skills=== The following [[Cluster Jewel]] passives are related to Cold Damage: {{Passive skill table |q_where= passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%" AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%cold%" AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%damage%" |large=1 |stat_text=1 }} ===Miscellany=== These passive skills are related to cold damage, but do not fit into any other category. {{Query base passive skills |where= ( passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%cold%damage%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%damage_%_to_add_as_cold%" ) AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%resist%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("cold_damage_+%", "cold_damage_with_attack_skills_+%") }} ===Historic keystone passive skills=== The following [[Historic]] jewel [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to cold damage: {{Passive skill table |q_where = ( passive_skills.id LIKE "%karui_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%templar_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%vaal_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%maraketh_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%eternal_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%kalguur_keystone%" OR passive_skills.id LIKE "%abyss%keystone%" ) AND passive_skills.name !="The Agnostic" AND passive_skills.name !="Glancing Blows" AND passive_skills.name !="Supreme Ego" AND passive_skills.name !="Wind Dancer" AND passive_skills.name !="Eternal Youth" AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%cold%" |stat_text=1 |large=1 }} ===Keystone passive skills=== The following [[keystone passive skill]]s are related to cold damage: {{Query keystone passive skills |where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Cold%" }} ===Masteries=== The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to cold damage: {{Query masteries}} ===Ascendancy passive skills=== The following [[Ascendancy passive skill]]s are related to cold damage: {{Query ascendancy passive skills |where= ( passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%cold%damage%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%damage_%_to_add_as_cold%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%convert_to_cold%" OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%reduce_enemy_cold_resistance%" ) AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%resist%" }} ===Tattoos=== {{Drop enabled item table |tables = tattoos |join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID |where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency" AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL AND items.description LIKE "%cold damage%" |large=1 |description=1 }} ==Monsters== Monsters with cold damage attacks include: * [[Maelström]] * [[Siren's Daughter]] (cast {{il|Freezing Pulse}}) * [[Water Elemental]] (cast {{il|Cold Snap}}, {{il|Ice Nova}}) Some [[Chimeral]]s, some [[Construct]]s, some [[Dockhand Wraith]]s, some [[Shield crab (monster type)|Shield Crabs]], some [[Skeleton]]s, some [[Skeletal Mage]]s, some [[Sand spitter (monster type)|Sand Spitters]], some [[Statue]]s, and some [[Undying]]s. Bosses with cold damage attacks include: * [[Hailrake]] (cast {{il|Glacial Cascade}}) * [[The Deep Dweller]] * [[Brood Princess]] (cast {{il|Freezing Pulse}}) * [[Chatters]] ({{il|Glacial Hammer}}) * [[Stranglecharm]] (cast {{il|Ice Nova}}) * [[Merveil, the Siren]] (Ice Storm, Barrage of Ice Spears, Freezing Pulse) * [[Banner of Knowledge]] ({{il|Hatred}} aura) * [[The Goddess of Purity]] (cast {{il|Ice Nova}}) * [[Piety]] (deals Cold Damage in Ice Archer form) * [[Thistlesage]] ({{il|Ice Spear}}, Ice Spears on Death ) * [[Imperator Stantinus Bitterblade]] (Cyclone Leaves Trail of Ice) ==Gallery== There is no default icon for cold damage / resistance, as well as cold-related buffs / debuffs and other cold-related game mechanics. In general, it is blue in colour. Read the skill gem articles for all the skill icons of [[Cold damage#Skill gems|cold skills]].
